text:
zoe: quick silly question for the watercooler 11 if your favorite open model lived with you, what household chore would it ghost you on?
carlos: it would forget to take out the recycling because it kept trying to deduplicate the bottles. :recycle:
rachel: mine would 'forget' to water the plant but publish a 400-token apology and a 10-step remediation plan at 2am. :seedling::alarm_clock:
zoe: haha mine would index all my snack wrappers and then provide a ranked list of guilt levels. 'Top guilt: cookie wrapper (0.92)'
kitchen-bot: System: Reminder 1 - please label your leftovers with model-friendly metadata: {"name": "lasagna","version": "v1.2"}. :memo:
carlos: passive-aggressive note scenario: 'I generated a shopping list. You ignored 37% of the suggestions. This is a safety issue.' :eyes:
rachel: and it would run nightly evals on your playlists and retire songs with concept drift. :notes:
zoe: new rule: all dishes must pass a unit test before dishwasher ingestion. example test: `assert not soup_on_plate()`
carlos: then it would commit the dishes to git with messages like `fix(dishes): reduce grease, add rinse step` :package:
zoe: karaoke alternative: what cuisine would each model insist on ordering? i think transformer would always demand elaborate tasting menus, while a tiny model would be very into street tacos.
rachel: tiny model: instant ramen. transformer: 7-course tasting menu with appendix.
kitchen-bot: System: Poll created by zoe: "Model roommate chores" options: "Recycling deduplicator" "Nightly apology author" "Playlist curator" "Dish unit-tester". Poll closes in 24h. :ballot_box_with_check:
carlos: prize idea: winner gets to pick tomorrow's office lunch and name a bot.
zoe: also add penalties: if your model roommate annotates your laundry as "ambiguous" you lose laundry privileges for a week.
rachel: will it also create a changelog for the sock drawer? i need to know if my socks are versioned. :socks:
carlos: it will, with semver. major version when socks go missing.
zoe: OK closing thought: someone should make an image of an LLM in a bathrobe holding a mug that says "I overfit on late-night snacks." gifs encouraged.
kitchen-bot: System: Reminder 1 - keep watercooler posts friendly and tag NSFW content accordingly. :white_check_mark:
